g.text: Days before or after the nearest local full moon
Acropora in historical records and in the Maldives · Teal bars cover days 0–7

text.style: font-size: 32.00px; font-weight: bold;fill: #183139; font-family: "Times New Roman";

g.text: Another field study shows a similar lunar rhythm
Historical study counts 400 genus/reef-dates. The Maldives study counts 81 spawning atoll-days. Survey coverage differs.
Sources: Baird et al. (2021) and Sheridan et al. (2025). Similar event distributions do not establish identical underlying populations.
